Lower Text: [Security] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 card with [Pulsemon] in its text among them to the hand. Return the rest to the bottom of the deck. Then, place this card in the battle area.
Upper Text: [Main] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 card with [Pulsemon] in its text among them to the hand. Return the rest to the bottom of the deck. Then, place this card in the battle area.
・By placing the top card of 1 of your level 4 or higher Digimon with [Pulsemon] in its text on top of your security stack, gain 2 memory.
